name: Box step-up
form_cues: Put your whole foot on the box.
Drive up through the front heel, not the back toe.
common_mistakes: Box too high for your hip mobility
safety: Use a stable box that can't slide; start with knee height or lower.
notes: Hold dumbbells at your sides to add load.

name: Superman hold
form_cues: Lie face down, arms stretched overhead.
Lift arms, chest and legs a few centimetres together.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
common_mistakes: Lifting too high and pinching the lower back
safety: Keep the lift small; stop if you feel lower-back pain.
